Bill.BriefDescription: Repealing the sales tax exemption for coal used at a coal-fired thermal generation facility.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to repealing the sales tax exemption for coal usedat a coal-fired thermal generation facility; repealing RCW 82.08.811and 82.12.811; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The following acts or parts of acts are eachrepealed: RCW 82.08.811 (ExemptionsCoal used at coalfired thermalelectric generation facilityApplicationDemonstration of progress inair pollution controlNotice of emissions violationsReapplicationPayments on cessation of operation) and 1997 c 368 s 4; and RCW 82.12.811 (ExemptionsCoal used at coalfired thermalelectric generation facilityApplicationDemonstration of progress inair pollution controlNotice of emissions violationsReapplicationPayments on cessation of operation) and 1997 c 368 s 6.
